LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicEmitter_Ready: Ready, waiting for hostiles in range
LanguageData.DMS_BlastScanner_IgniteDesc: Light the fuse on the loaded charge. When it burns down, the shockwave maps several deep ore deposits across the map, and is very likely to wake dormant insects underground.
LanguageData.DMS_BlastScanner_NoCharge: No charge loaded. Load a high-explosive shell first.
LanguageData.DMS_BlastScanner_NothingFound: The {0} detonated, but the echoes revealed nothing new.
LanguageData.DMS_BlastScanner_InsectsText: The shockwave from the {0} has woken an insect colony dormant underground. They are digging their way to the surface.
